name: Apple
description: Maker of the iPhone, Mac and a large services business. A mega-cap tech company.

name: Microsoft
description: Software and cloud giant behind Windows, Office and Azure.

name: NVIDIA
description: Designs the chips that power gaming and AI. Strong growth, large swings.

name: Amazon
description: E-commerce and cloud computing (AWS) leader.

name: Alphabet
description: Parent of Google and YouTube; revenue mostly from advertising.

name: Tesla
description: Electric vehicles and energy storage. Famous for sharp price moves.

name: Johnson & Johnson
description: Healthcare group (pharma and medical devices). A classic defensive stock.

name: Coca-Cola
description: Global beverage brand with steady revenue and regular dividends.

name: JPMorgan Chase
description: Largest US bank. Its price follows the economic cycle closely.

name: Walmart
description: World's largest retailer. Stable demand, even in downturns.

name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
description: Tracks the 500 largest US companies in a single fund.

name: Invesco QQQ (Nasdaq 100)
description: Tracks 100 big Nasdaq companies, heavy on technology.

name: Vanguard Total US Market
description: Owns almost the entire US stock market, from large to small caps.

name: Vanguard Total World
description: Thousands of companies across the world in one fund. Maximum diversification.

name: Vanguard Developed Markets
description: Companies from Europe, Japan and other developed countries outside the US.

name: iShares Emerging Markets
description: Companies from emerging countries such as China, India and Brazil.

name: iShares Russell 2000
description: US small caps: smaller companies, usually more volatile than large ones.

name: iShares Core US Bonds
description: A basket of US bonds. Typically calmer than stocks, with lower growth.

name: SPDR Gold Shares
description: Follows the gold price. Often seen as a safe haven in uncertain times.

name: Vanguard Real Estate
description: Listed real-estate companies (offices, housing, warehouses).

name: Bitcoin
description: The first and largest cryptocurrency. Digital, scarce, and very volatile.

name: Ethereum
description: A programmable blockchain used for apps and tokens.

name: Solana
description: A fast blockchain for apps. Young, ambitious and highly volatile.

name: BNB
description: The token of the Binance ecosystem.

name: XRP
description: A crypto designed for fast cross-border payments.

name: Cardano
description: A research-driven blockchain platform.

name: Dogecoin
description: Started as a joke; moves mostly with social media hype.

name: Avalanche
description: A blockchain for apps focused on speed and low fees.

name: Polkadot
description: Connects different blockchains together.

name: Chainlink
description: Feeds real-world data to blockchains.
